The '''Daupherm Merchant Space Fleet''' was a merchant fleet that operated in the [[Daupherm Planet States]].

==History==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Evram Darkmere]] joined the fleet when he was twelve years old, signing on as a cabin boy. He rose through the ranks, until he eventually became a second-in-command. However, he was forced to leave the fleet when he was drafted into the [[Daupherm Marine Corps]].<ref name="CRO" />
